note: The PR-8 golden prompts. Prompts 14 and 15 name no commander, so the generator must pick one. A user who delegates the pick makes D-147 and D-208 skip the slot (D-232). Prompt 13 names a commander the collection does not hold, on purpose: owned-first must warn and still build (D-37). Prompts 2 and 5 name owned commanders, so an accidental warning never hides a real one. Each one is a session whose slots are all answered, which is where the generator takes over. The set covers the three formats the app builds (D-155), both pool modes (D-37), every power shape, and the two build rules that are not rules of the game: the precon share (D-218) and a locked card (D-70).
